summary.text: Song Tao Zi is a peak rank seven Gu Immortal of Wind Cloud Manor, named among the top three rank seven Gu Immortals of Central Continent.

claims.text: In an Eastern Sea dream realm, an intense battle reaches its climax. He is covered in injuries but his aura is strong, and he firmly suppresses Wu Shuai. He shouts that Wu Shuai did not stop his killer move, then raises his head. Observing Gu Immortals call him a peak rank seven of Wind Cloud Manor whose battle strength is definitely top three within Central Continent’s rank seven Gu Immortals. The fight was already agreed with Wind Cloud Manor to decide ownership of South Flower Island.

He uses his famous killer move Green Heaven Pine Wave. Dense green light covers him and spreads, traces resembling pine leaves, layers stacking toward Wu Shuai. Watchers ask how many rank seven Gu Immortals in Central Continent, or in the entire five regions, can defend against that move. Wu Shuai has been waiting for it. He enters Dragon Court. The palace treats the green light as harmless air and carves a pathway. Song Tao Zi is furious and shocked as his proudest killer move is treated as nothing.

Wu Shuai tells him to kneel and beg for mercy, and he will spare his life. Song Tao Zi has a pale expression and refuses in a rage, saying a mere dragonman dares to humiliate him. He will not back down. Surrounding Wind Cloud Manor Gu Immortals shout for mercy. Wu Shuai uses Dragon Court to charge over. Song Tao Zi cannot dodge in time and is crushed to death. The battle had been announced to the world as a life-and-death fight. Wind Cloud Manor loses South Flower Island and still sends an ordinary rank six envoy to the celebratory banquet, for righteous reputation and to show magnanimity. Wu Shuai calls Song Tao Zi a good opponent who deserves the glory of dying in heroic combat.

He is covered in injuries, with a strong aura, while suppressing Wu Shuai. When he casts Green Heaven Pine Wave, his body glows in dense green light. Traces of that light resemble pine leaves, and layers of it stack outward. When Dragon Court approaches he has a pale expression.

Later narration states that Wu Shuai made a bet with Wind Cloud Manor and used Dragon Court to kill Song Tao Zi in front of everyone, becoming renowned in the world. The battle also motivated the dragonman race. Decades later Wu Shuai tells Gu Liang that when he killed Song Tao Zi he thought it would be a turning point for the dragonman race’s rise.
